messages:
Sam Chen: Hey team — putting a proposal on the table for canary rollouts that need to do regional spillover when a region is capacity-constrained.

Sam Chen: TL;DR: traffic should spill to (1) warmed compatible model variant in-region, (2) other region with >X% spare capacity, (3) lower-cost quantized variant, with configurable weights and safety guards.

Priya Nair: 👍 agree in principle. Question: how do we measure 'spare capacity'? Pod GPU util? queued requests? both?

Miguel Soto: Prefer queued requests + recent p95 latency delta. GPU util is noisy across models.

Anika Rao: UX question: should these policies live in the Console rollout wizard or be API-first and surfaced in Console? I vote API-first with sane Console defaults.

Tara Williams: API-first is good. Also need rollout-level telemetry: fallback_count, fallback_path, fallback_latency_delta, spillover_region.

deply-bot: Deploy plan created for feature/rollout-spillover with PR #4523

deploy-bot: sorry typo above (deploy-bot)

Sam Chen: Proposed draft policy schema (pseudo):
```
rollout: {
  canary_percent: 10,
  fallbacks: [
    {type: "warm_variant", weight: 0.6, min_warm: 2},
    {type: "regional_spill", weight: 0.3, min_free_capacity_pct: 15},
    {type: "quantized_fallback", weight: 0.1}
  ],
  safety_guards: {max_concurrent_fallbacks: 50, p95_latency_increase_threshold: 200}
}
```

Priya Nair: min_free_capacity_pct should be dynamic, maybe compare to baseline from last 24h. Otherwise we might prematurely spill.

Miguel Soto: Agree. Also we should include cooldown windows per-region to avoid flip-flopping.

Anika Rao: On the console, show a small simulation preview: estimated spillover distribution given current capacity and historical traffic.

Tara Williams: telemetry-bot: I'll add events -> rollout.fallback.triggered with tags {policy, path, from_region, to_region, request_id} 

Sam Chen: Decision for now: API-first policy schema, Console UI with templates and simulation. Telemetry events + dashboard panels (fallback rate, avg latency delta, spillover heatmap). Action: @Miguel Soto implement policy evaluator, @Tara Williams add events, @Priya Nair define capacity signals.

Priya Nair: I'll draft capacity signal doc and proposed thresholds by EOD Friday.

Miguel Soto: I'll spin up a PoC evaluator to run against saved traces.

Anika Rao: I'll mock the Console simulation UI next week.

Sam Chen: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after PoC. (reacts :party-parrot:)
